subject: VM evidence request: scan cadence, SLA and CVE attestation
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@finbridge.com>

Cc: security@finbridge.com
Date: 2026-11-09T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: VM evidence request for SOC2/Q4 audit

Karthik,

As part of our SOC 2 readiness for Q4, our audit team needs a compact package demonstrating Redwood's vulnerability management posture. Specifically we need: 
- Scan cadence for infrastructure and container images (last 6 months)
- SLA for critical/important CVE remediation and examples of closure timelines
- A signed attestation that fixes for CVE-2026-1857 and CVE-2026-1984 were deployed to prod (or compensating controls documented)
- Any SIEM/alerting handoff evidence and timestamps for triage/patching

Can you provide a single packet (PDF/CSV) and a short attestation by 2026-11-20? If you need a scope clarification (prod only vs prod+staging), let me know.

Thanks,
Oliver Hayes
FinBridge - Security Audit

Attachments referenced: SIG questionnaire (filled) -- we'll attach after you confirm format/fields.

Oliver —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a consolidated packet and a signed attestation. Quick clarifications before we pull the artifacts: 
- Scope: default is prod + customer-facing staging. Confirm if you want internal-only environments included.
- For CVE-2026-1857 and CVE-2026-1984 we patched the runtime images and rotated vulnerable artifacts; I will include manifest rows with deployment timestamps.
- We will include both scan cadence (weekly infra, daily container image scans) and a CSV manifest that maps CVE -> PR/patch -> deploy time.

Kimberly, Marissa — looping you in for the artifact pull and attestation signing. Marissa, can you run the export of the last 6 months of scan snapshots and deliver the CSV by EOD 11/11? Kimberly, please confirm the remediation SLA table for inclusion.

I will prepare a short attestation template and circulate for signature.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our timeline is tight so please flag any blockers.

Oliver
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@finbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: VM evidence request for SOC2/Q4 audit

Oliver —

Attached is the consolidated evidence packet for your SOC 2 audit (prod + customer-facing staging only), and a signed attestation. Brief summary in-body below. Attachments: SIG_Questionnaire_FinBridge_Q4-2026.pdf, vm_scan_summary_Q3-2026.pdf, cve_fix_manifest_finbridge_2026-11.csv, karthik_attestation_signed.pdf

Summary (high level):
- Scan cadence: infra host scans are run weekly (every Monday 02:00 UTC); container image scans are daily on CI pipeline completion. We have retained snapshots for the last 6 months in the attached PDF and CSV.
- SLA table (included): Critical: 48 hours from detection to mitigation (deploy or compensating control); High/Important: 7 days; Medium: 30 days. These are enforced via our ticketing automation and tracked in JIRA-4521 (example trace included).
- CVE attestations: CVE-2026-1857 (runtime allocator) 
  - Detection: 2026-10-14T03:41:00Z
  - PR merged: 2026-10-15T11:12:00Z
  - Prod deploy: 2026-10-15T18:45:00Z
  - Evidence: cve_fix_manifest_finbridge_2026-11.csv (row entries show image digest and deploy timestamps)

  CVE-2026-1984 (third-party lib)
  - Detection: 2026-09-22T04:07:00Z
  - Mitigation applied (upgrade + compensating WAF rule): 2026-09-23T16:00:00Z
  - Evidence: manifest rows + WAF rule change log (referenced in PDF).

- SIEM/alerting: Triage events for both CVEs were ingested, alerts were created at the detection timestamp and linked to remediation tickets. Sample timestamps are embedded in the CSV.

Attestation (excerpt):
"I, Karthik Iyer, Director of Security & Compliance at Redwood Inference, attest that the remediation steps and deployment timestamps for CVE-2026-1857 and CVE-2026-1984 are complete for production and customer-facing staging environments, as documented in the attached manifest. Where immediate patching was not possible, compensating controls were implemented and documented in the evidence packet."

Signed: karthik_attestation_signed.pdf (DocuSign receipt and signature block included).

If the auditor needs raw logs or additional SIEM exports we'll coordinate an access window next week.

Thanks — let us know if you want the packet expanded to include internal-only environments.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
